items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: The only time we had that is when we was playing that Tom Anderson on Rampart and Canal.

ctx.x: But only people in the band sang, not extra. No, not, there's not one. You wouldn't hire an extra. Only one. Yeah, but I mean you wouldn't hire an extra man or an extra woman to sing.

No, no. The only time we had that is when we was playing that Tom Anderson on Rampart and Canal. You remember Tom Anderson was the fellow who had all those big houses there in the district they used to call it.
Did Miss Todd accompany herself while she played and sang, or did you other instruments count?
